scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @renew/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @renew/shared" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @renew/shared && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @renew/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
